name: custom-employee-portal
description: Custom Employee Portal with Role-Based Access Control and Zoho One API Integration

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const b = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'start'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const f = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
